scope: U01-U08; final user goal supersedes the earlier six-character visual recheck

openFindings.finding: Exploration previously owned a second arena/HUD/timer. Sharing BattleMoves alone does not satisfy reuse.
openFindings.requiredEvidence: All four actual entry paths render the same BattleScreen, controller, HUD, log and animation; contextual settlement keeps the originating session ID.

openFindings.finding: The six-character roster has water, fire and metal only.
openFindings.requiredEvidence: Distinct wood and earth artwork and usable instances, with consistent resource/element identity in adoption, detail, desktop, chat, battle and territory.

openFindings.finding: presentation.cjs infers freeze from a successful water action although the engine applies immediate rage reduction without freeze.
openFindings.requiredEvidence: Actual water result shows rage reduction, no invented freeze/stun, no disabled turn.

openFindings.finding: The engine's action-missed note also covers normal interrupting element. The view currently renders every miss as successful dodge.
openFindings.requiredEvidence: Normal-vs-element interruption and dodge-vs-normal avoidance have distinct truthful animation and events.

openFindings.finding: Natural-gameplay attempts cannot provide deterministic ultimate coverage; earlier failed harness evidence is retained.
openFindings.requiredEvidence: A verified isolated QA profile supplies a legal charged state; all four controls, repeated actions, elemental effects, ultimate cost/heal/hit, restart and reduced motion are independently observed.

deliveryGate: Each module self-verifies real Electron, main chat independently reviews, concrete failures return to the owning chat. Final integrated acceptance and current-workspace delivery follow only after all required work passes.
provenance: Controlled engine fixtures and isolated simulated transport/location are not live cloud or real GPS evidence.
